messages.text:
LMAO 😂 this thing is the *Elder God of Jank*.  

Let’s break it down:  

- **Name:** *Progenitus and Progenitus and Progenitus* — because apparently one wasn’t terrifying enough. Hydra Hydra Hydra indeed.  
- **Mana cost:** I count… five of each color?? That’s basically “sell your soul, mortgage your house, and sacrifice a goat” levels of cost.  
- **Type line:** *Legendary Creature — Hydra Hydra Hydra Avatar Avatar Avatar.* Just in case you didn’t get it the first time, it’s a Hydra. And also, an Avatar. But thrice.  
- **Text box:**  
  - "Protection from everything" x3. Because once wasn’t enough.  
  - Then it turns into absolute nonsense philosophy:  
    *If they would, they don’t. If they could, they can’t. If they may, they must. If you couldn’t, you may. If they want to, they can’t. If you want it, you have it. If you want to, you may.*  
    …bro this is not Magic: the Gathering, this is a Zen koan wrapped in a paradox burrito.  

- **Power/Toughness:** 30/30. Of course. Why not.  

Honestly this feels like the **Elder Hydra of Bureaucratic Rulings**, a card that exists solely to make the judge at a tournament cry blood.  

Would you even *play* this thing or just frame it and whisper riddles at it?

I've played some janky shit but .. lol

Nah I just find it funny considering our last Hydra convo

Hahaha yesss, it really is *cosmic timing*. Last time you dropped that thought experiment Hydra — where chopping a head off doesn’t just grow two more, but an entire *new Hydra* from the stump — neck to neck, infinite fractal Hydra recursion.  

And now this monstrosity shows up: **Progenitus³**, the Magic card equivalent of "Hydra, but turned up until the dial snaps off."  

- Your Hydra idea = metaphysical nightmare math creature.  
- This fake card Hydra = parody nightmare rules creature.  

Both basically boil down to the same vibe: *“If you fight me, you lose. If you don’t fight me, you still lose.”*  

Like the multiverse itself was like,  
> “Oh, Shawn’s talking about infinite Hydras again? Better spawn a meme version with Protection From Everything Everything Everything.”  

🤣  

Want me to riff a *card text version* of your Hydra concept, just to see how cursed and janky it would look as an actual Magic card?
Sure lol, no just make the card, or try to

Alright, let’s crank this jank machine into overdrive 🤣  

Here’s my attempt at turning your **recursive fractal Hydra of Hydras** into a Magic-style card:  

---

**Fractalus, the Ever-Splintering Hydra**  
{2}{G}{G}{U}{B}  
Legendary Creature — Hydra Horror  

Trample  

Whenever Fractalus is dealt damage, for each 1 damage dealt, create a token that’s a copy of Fractalus, except it has base power and toughness equal to half the damage dealt (rounded up).  

Each Hydra token created this way has this ability.  

At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are 100 or more creatures named Fractalus on the battlefield, you win the game.  

*"From every head, a Hydra. From every Hydra, a thousand heads."*  

30/30  

---

This one would basically make every judge scoop their binder and leave the room.  
It’s like: *“Okay, so I Shock it for 2… oh god, now there’s TWO smaller Hydras, each with the same text… wait, now each one splits further next time? …oh no.”*  

Would you like me to mock it up into an **actual card image** (like that Progenitus meme) so you can see the cursed thing in full glory?
That's actually... No it's still busted but it's manageable lol

😂 Yeah exactly — it’s **broken**, but in a way where at least people can *attempt* to keep track of it without inventing a new branch of mathematics mid-game.  

Instead of "Hydra of Hydras until infinity" it’s:  
- ✅ Recursive, but capped by damage events.  
- ✅ Gives you tokens, but they scale down.  
- ✅ Has an absurd wincon, but only if you *really commit to the nonsense*.  

It’s like the difference between “haha, funny impossible meme” (Progenitus³) vs. “technically legal but your playgroup will stop inviting you” (Fractalus).  

Want me to draft a **slightly saner** version too — like something that could almost pass as a *real* mythic Hydra WotC might actually print?
